literal: To those who are not capable of smiling and socializing, the great vast world, even in the daytime, is fallen into the side of darkness.
translation: To those who cannot smile and be friendly with others, this vast, great world is enveloped in pitch darkness, even during the broad daylight.
modern: பிறரோடு கலந்து பழகி மகிழ முடியாதவர்களுக்கு, இந்தப் பெரிய பரந்த உலகம் பகல் நேரத்திலும் இருளில் மூழ்கியதாகவே தோன்றும்.
explanation: This couplet highlights the importance of a cheerful, sociable disposition as a key aspect of courtesy. The word 'நகல்' refers to smiling, laughing, and warm social interaction. For those who lack this ability ('வல்லர் அல்லார்க்கு'), the vast world ('மா இரு ஞாலம்') holds no joy or light. Even during the bright day ('பகலும்'), their lives feel as though they are plunged into darkness ('இருள் பால் பட்டன்று') because they isolate themselves from the warmth of human connection.
